notes.content: Modify the difficulty of obtaining endings.
We've optimized the animation prompt UI for clearer, more intuitive display. Also, if your level is high enough, you can now engage in XXOO animations by talking to the female staff.

1 Previously, the addition of a shaking camera effect in sex animations could cause the scene to freeze when transitioning.

We've now added a feature where you can press and hold the ESC key on your keyboard to immediately exit the animation and return to the main scene. This should prevent any further hangups.

2 The difficulty of the jigsaw puzzle game has been lowered.

Save Issue Fixed: You can now properly save your game progress.

Increased Rope Climbing Attempts: You can now perform more rope climbing actions.

Animation View Switch Bug Fixed: Resolved an error that occurred when switching animation views.

Volume Control Added: You can now adjust the in-game volume to your preference.

Streamlined Work System: Earning money from part-time jobs no longer requires puzzles; you'll now get direct monetary rewards.

Easier Gym Training: We've reduced the difficulty of gym training, making it much simpler to complete.

Fixed a bug where the female staff's animation wouldn't exit correctly.

Lowered overall game difficulty by:

Increasing the number of stealth failures allowed.

Decreasing the difficulty of strength training.

Addressed various other bugs to improve stability and performance.

We've optimized the massage mode, making it simpler to use:

No more progress bars: You no longer need to use a progress bar to determine massage progress.

Click to enter: Just click to directly enter massage mode.
We've fixed some bugs, lowered shop item prices, and made it easier to earn money.
